## Deterministic tools for every file format

### Compare

Our rules-based redline engine, written in Rust, guarantees the precision you need to harness LLM based workflows, and scales to thousands of .docx, .doc, and .pdf files.

### Track

Every draft of a document, one history. Track layers each turn of a negotiation into a single tracked-changes document, attributing every surviving change to the version and author that introduced it. Blame for contracts, built the same deterministic way.

### Merge

Three reviewers, three marked-up copies, one draft. Merge reconciles parallel revisions of the same base into a single tracked-changes document, attributes each edit to its source, and flags the places where reviewers overwrote each other instead of silently picking a winner.
